authoring_basis.authorization: User authorized Codex to replace the test fish, bite, and fight tables with an agent-authored formal table following the existing product-document direction because final planning decisions are not yet available.
authoring_basis.scope: This package closes the fish/bite/fight runtime input gap for the current DeliveryHarnessAssets module. It does not claim final product balance or final visual/presentation content.
authoring_basis.review_policy: When planning provides final rarity, bait preference, behavior, effect, or art mapping decisions, update the same assets/package instead of reopening scattered sub-tasks.

fish_table.title: 鱼表格
fish_table.available_fact: The 第一版 sheet now has 16 base fish rows with names, regions, weight ranges, strength coefficient K, fight stamina, chum attribute, buff/effect notes, duration, sacrifice notes, and experience ranges. These rows are the base row source for the generated UE fish assets.
fish_table.agent_decision: Empty preference bait and rarity columns were filled by Codex using the table's chum/effect semantics, existing equipment bait IDs, and rarity weight tiers Common/Uncommon/Rare/Event.

fish_book.title: 鱼
fish_book.available_fact: The fish book declares the fish table as the fish-data SSOT and defines the intended axes: distribution, chum, weight, bait preference, buff, and experience.
fish_book.agent_decision: Codex kept the UE data centered on those axes instead of adding a temporary runtime JSON or code-side fish table.

fish_owner_decision_sync.title: 裁决同步 · 鱼／营地／UI 与交互（张佳）
fish_owner_decision_sync.available_fact: The owner-sync page identifies the fish table completion as a delivery dependency and lists missing columns such as preference bait, rarity, diet, outward segment length, rest segment length, and movement speed coefficient.
fish_owner_decision_sync.agent_decision: Codex used this as the shape of the provisional formal table and generated explicit UE fish, bite, and fight assets so the runtime no longer depends on test DataAssets.

fish_behavior_doc.title: 鱼的行为
fish_behavior_doc.available_fact: The behavior plan gives the intended bite/fight thinking: diet-driven bite differences, 3-6 second outward segments, 2-5 second rest segments, weight-class movement coefficients, line-length rhythm, and giant-fish exception semantics.
fish_behavior_doc.agent_decision: Codex generated four BitePersonality assets and four FightPersonality assets from that direction: cautious, steady, aggressive, giant, and small/medium/large/giant fight rhythms.

bait_table.title: 窝料/饵
bait_table.available_fact: Chum and bait candidate tables exist and the project already has formal bait equipment assets.
bait_table.agent_decision: Codex mapped fishy/fragrant/fermented fish to existing bait IDs such as MeatBait, BugBait, FruitBait, NectarBait, MoonlightBait, SoundBait, FlashingBait, and GiantLureBait.

eating_effect_doc.title: 吃鱼效果
eating_effect_doc.available_fact: Effect families, yellow stamina, poison, no-effect fish, giant sacrifice blessing, and reconciliation notes are documented.
eating_effect_doc.agent_decision: Codex mapped puffer, electric eel, and pike to Toxic fish definitions with positive PoisonIncrease, and kept non-toxic rows Safe with midpoint experience values. Special buff presentation/effect execution remains owned by the non-fish content package.

art_resource_sheet.title: 临时美术资源表格
art_resource_sheet.available_fact: Fish art resource categories exist, including fish, fish animation, quality/size variants, and fish shadow categories.
art_resource_sheet.agent_decision: Because no per-fish UE model mapping is available, this package only completes data readiness. Presentation and art binding remain in FormalNonFishContentInputPackage.

runtime_fit_notes: FishStrength uses the fish table's maximum weight multiplied by strength coefficient K.
TimeOfDay and Weather are intentionally broad for this provisional table so the current lake runtime can select every fish in normal daytime weather states.
StinkyFish uses SacrificeContribution=1 instead of the design note -1 because UCatFishDefinition::IsRuntimeDefinitionReady currently rejects non-positive sacrifice values.

LakeGiantShadow uses Safe/EatingExperience=1 with bTankDisplayEligible=false because the current FoodSafety enum has no NonEdible value; its actual giant blessing/effect remains a later presentation/effect-content concern.
CaptureImprintEventId stays None for all generated fish so data readiness does not invent missing imprint event assets.

retired_assets.reason: These prototype-only assets are no longer registered by runtime config. Their binary packages remain until an Unreal Editor reference audit can prove deletion is safe; runtime and verification paths must not use them.

asset_readiness_rule: This package is ready when generated fish, bite, and fight DataAssets exist, Config/DefaultGame.ini references them instead of DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, or DA_Fight_Test01, and blocking_gaps is empty. The package remains provisional product content, but no longer blocks the runtime from using formal fish assets.
historical_metadata_notice: 2026-08-25 authoring_basis/sources/runtime_fit_notes describe the original generated snapshot, not current field values. current_migration retains the 2026-09-15 numeric migration and its original hashes. subsequent_migrations records ordered later changes with before/after asset hashes; only the final snapshot is compared with current asset files. None of these records closes a delivery module.

current_migration.scope: 16 fish approved numeric fields, rarity, chum class, bait matrix and windows; stable runtime IDs and presentation references preserved

current_migration.bait_source: Knowledge/Design/GDD 系统分册/鱼/鱼表格/饵权重.csv

subsequent_migrations.scope: Only FightBodyGeometry on the same 16 formal fish definitions; all other serialized properties preserved. This follows the numeric migration recorded in current_migration without replacing its historical hashes.

calibration_basis.mouth: Bone014 upper-lip reference pose, inspected on all 16 source meshes and transformed to Encounter Actor local centimeters
calibration_basis.center_of_mass: Reference Mesh origin transformed to Actor local space; gameplay approximation, not measured mass distribution
calibration_basis.scale_origin: EncounterMeshRelativeTransform translation; points scale around this origin and yaw radius scales by VisualScale
calibration_basis.yaw_radius: sqrt((L^2 + W^2) / 12), imported mesh bounds with Encounter base scale, in centimeters; uniform-body inertia approximation

verification.evidence_scope: UE asset calibration and fresh-process field verification only; these ignored local reports are historical execution evidence, not required files for the portable snapshot checker. Does not close runtime behavior or presentation delivery.
